body.says: One expression, of the author's or of whoever its voice says, as one message: a stretch of time in which his words bounce off each other more than off the same words elsewhere. Its parts are paragraphs and breaks, in order.

as.says: How it came: typed or spoken.

at.says: The moment it came, as the log writes one; kept since 2026-11-11.

context.says: How much of the session’s context window was in use when it came, in percent, as the app counts it; so a later session sees where compaction was near.

effort.says: The effort the session ran at, as the app names it: low, medium, high and on.

flow.says: Its paragraphs and breaks, in order.

model.says: The model the session ran on while it was said or answered, by its id; kept since 2026-11-11.
